contracts.asserts: The actual full runtime entry rejects empty/unrelated reports and partial gated-function measurement before it can claim coverage; recording compiler/gcov controls are synthetic admission evidence
Filtered and bypass boundaries, coordinate continuity, immediate motion/reversal/stop, independence/reset and normal-filter negative control

Initialization, RDY/retry, I2C failures, recovery and PM state; initial failed-mask edge recovery, retained Event Mode after PM resume, interrupted boot recovery, own-queue rejection before side effects; runtime IRQ re-arm and rejected-suspend IRQ restore failures retain recovery; first failed mask preserves in-flight report ownership
Contact and button report lifecycle in filtered and bypass builds; retained filtered traces and immediate unfiltered output/invalid/rotation/independence traces
API/kernel result paths reject relative/existing/symlink/dangling paths before west, preserve sentinel and avoid creating dangling targets

limits: Stub I2C/GPIO/PM does not establish electrical timing, real IRQ delivery or shared-bus fairness.

execution.default: quick: every behavioral fixture and scenario under ASan/UBSan once
execution.full: ZMK_TEST_MODE=full: same scenarios plus optimized, coverage and existing 32-bit variants
execution.integration: owner native/DTS/API guards when interfaces or kernel contracts change; not a prerequisite for pure host behavior
execution.transport: actual ordered USB/BLE/split/power/reset evidence; archived simulation is not a passing substitute

kernel.asserts: Actual ordinary/delayed work cannot cancel itself synchronously; own-queue suspend returns EWOULDBLOCK without state changes, external suspend/resume remains usable; two cases x three identical-binary runs
kernel.negative_control: --negative-control invalid-priority requires named compile rejection; no runtime execution is reported as a passing control
kernel.limits: Actual kernel cancellation with GPIO emulation; no physical bus, sensor or downstream transport evidence
